goal: Make the manager workbench target Hong Kong date selectable with a native calendar while preserving the YYYYMMDD URL/API contract, and label the existing US-to-HK table as research candidates rather than formal selections.
forbidden_paths: Backend, selection, ranking, gates, data, saved runs, schedulers, or other modules
Provider, POST, service lifecycle, runtime static files, Git commit/push, or external actions
pass_signal: The native date field displays the selected date and converts ISO display values to YYYYMMDD before existing URL/API navigation.
Changing the date clears phase/run_id through existing changeDate navigation; popstate updates the picker; an empty picker value issues no request and does not default to today.
The existing full candidate table remains intact and gets a dynamic count label that says it is not formal selection; missing candidate data is shown as unknown.
The focused component test, web typecheck, and isolated web build pass; independent review is still required for acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop if active release source or static inventory drifts from the verified baseline, if a change outside the listed paths is required, or before any runtime/static publication or service action.
